cd /app/varsea && echo '=== PASSWORD grep (text) ==='; grep -rla 'PASSWORD' . 2>/dev/null; echo '=== 8XD grep (text) ==='; grep -rla '8XD' . 2>/dev/null; echo '=== binary pattern search all bins ==='; for f in */*.bin; do echo "--- $f"; python3 - "$f" <<'EOF'
import sys,re
d=open(sys.argv[1],'rb').read()
print('len',len(d))
for pat in (b'PASSWORD',b'8XD',b'W54',b'launchcode'):
    i=d.find(pat)
    print(pat, i)
# chunk entropy/printability profile
for off in range(0,len(d),512):
    c=d[off:off+512]
    pr=sum(1 for x in c if 32<=x<127)/len(c)
    print(off, round(pr,2), c[:16].hex())
EOF
done
